title: How do I cancel a CONTRACT: Voiding an agreement within 3 to 7 days using UCC 1-308 - Tickets Etc.
summary: Short video claiming tickets and contracts can be voided by writing 'UCC 1-308 refused' and returning them within a three- or seven-day cooling-off window.

assertions.quote: put on there ucc 1-308 refused put your either your name or your signature on there and send it back for those three days

verdicts.note: Traffic citations are not contracts and the UCC has no refusal mechanism; the charge proceeds regardless.
The section covers performance under reservation of rights in commercial dealings; it contains no time limit and no mechanism for voiding citations.

assertions.quote: this voids contracts if in fact it's a contract
you can still cancel up to seven business days later and you're still good to go

verdicts.note: Cooling-off rights exist only for specific transactions such as door-to-door sales or some loans, not contracts in general.

assertions.quote: i don't want everybody sending me letters for it i mean i'm gonna charge you for it
